thread:
jess: heads up — starting onboarding for narwhal-11b (INT8) today. goal: hosted + dedicated canary, then private. need a compact rollout checklist and fallback plan. aiming for similar latency/cost to vesta7b but better on long-context stability.

arjun: timeline? are we doing a small % hosted canary first or go straight to dedicated?

jess: start small hosted canary (1% queries) for 48h, then 10% for 24h if metrics look good. dedicated canary after hosted parity verified.

mia: quick note — int8 fp16->int8 conversion yields ~2.8x perf in local bench. but some generation quality diffs on long-context summarization. we need targeted eval prompts.

luis: infra checklist: ensure kv-cache size tuned, GPU memory plan for 11B int8, and fallback model variants available (narwhal-11b-fp16, vesta7b-quant).

sage: propose rollout gating metrics: p95 latency < 250ms for short prompts, p95 < 900ms for 2k token walks; end-to-end cost within 1.1x of vesta baseline; QA regression < 1.5% on eval suite; no more than 0.3% soft-fail rate.

pm-oliver: customer impact — make sure we can rollback to vesta7b instantly if production regressions hit. need a communication plan for customers on Dedicated contracts.

infra-oncall: memory note — INT8 model + kernel selection increases peak CPU pre/post processing. Watch node OOMs on older Dedicated instances. Recommend adding headroom and monitoring.

jess: good call. add auto-fallback route: if model p95 latency > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% for 10m, route to vesta7b-compat model; include per-customer override.

mia: will run eval harness (linted prompts + production prompt capture) and share regression matrix. running: qa/regressions/narwhal-11b/int8/ — placeholder for results.

luis: rollout commands for hosted canary (example):

```bash
# create canary route
redwood routes create --model narwhal-11b-int8 --route /gen/narwhal-canary --percent 1 --region us-west1
# add fallback
redwood routes update /gen/narwhal-canary --fallback vesta7b-quant
```

sage: monitoring hooks: add these dashboards/alerts before increasing traffic:
- tokens/s and per-token cost
- p95/p99 latency per model and per-route
- quality regression alert tied to eval set (alert if delta > threshold)
- tail-error spike alert (>0.5% in 5m)

devex-bot: docs/runbooks/narwhal-11b-onboard.md created — includes onboarding checklist, eval links, and canary playbook. https://internal/docs/narwhal-11b-onboard

pm-oliver: add customer comms draft: short note + rollback SLA and contact for Dedicated customers. Also decide whether to gate Private deploys until 1 week of stable canary. I vote yes.

jess: propose final checklist items to mark DONE before 10% ramp:
- eval regressions < threshold (mia)
- perf parity vs vesta within cost target (arjun+luis)
- fallback route and instant rollback tested (luis+infra-oncall)
- dashboards + alerts active (sage)
- customer comms ready for Dedicated (pm-oliver)
- privacy/keys validated for Private (security sign-off)

arjun: can we add a quantization sanity test in prod canary? e.g., run golden prompts that check hallucination and repetition on long docs. fail fast.

mia: yes — I'll add 50 golden prompts and a sliding window QA check that runs every 10m against canary traffic samples. results posted to the eval channel and webhook triggers alerts.

infra-oncall: I'll add node-level OOM + GPU mem pressure alerts and set autoscaler conservative for first 72h.

jess: timeline recap — Day 0: create hosted 1% canary, enable dashboards; Day 2: 10% if no alerts; Day 4: dedicated canary (restricted tenants); Day 7: private gating decision. rollback plan in place.

pm-oliver: sounds good. can someone own the post-rollout quality sweep? want a short report after 72h.

mia: I'll own the quality sweep and publish a short report (metrics + examples) at +72h.

jess: thanks all — tagging followups: @mia will post eval matrix, @luis + @infra-oncall for rollback test, @sage for alerts. I'll kick off the hosted canary in ~30m. :rocket:

devex-bot: deploy job queued: narwhal-11b-int8-canary-1769001234. Track: https://ci.internal/jobs/1769001234

luis: kicked off rollback smoke test now. logs in infra/logs/1769001234-rollback-smoke. so far green.

jess: closing thread — will reopen if any canary issues.
